_meta.note: This module's own texts. The host reads this file from locales/en.json beside the bundle's entry and merges it under the module's namespace. Copy it to <tag>.json to translate; a key you leave out falls back to the line here.
machines.settings.title: Moonraker
machines.settings.body: Add a Klipper machine that runs Moonraker. This server connects to it, so the machine needs no settings file.
machines.steps.label: Steps to add a machine
machines.steps.address.caption: Where Moonraker answers
machines.steps.details.caption: Name and identity
machines.steps.waiting.caption: This server dials the machine
machines.steps.connected.caption: Ready to print
machines.address.title: Where is the machine?
machines.address.lead: Give the address of the machine's Moonraker.
machines.address.label: Address
machines.address.help: A host name or IP address, with a port if it is not 7125. A URL works too.
machines.address.invalid: Enter a host, host:port or a URL.
machines.details.title: Name the machine
machines.details.lead: The defaults are fine for most machines.
machines.name.label: Name
machines.name.help: Lower case letters, digits and dashes. It names this connection, and the printer takes its name from the machine.
machines.name.invalid: Use lower case letters, digits and dashes, up to 63 characters.
machines.unit.label: Identity
machines.unit.help: Keeps the printer the same one if its address changes. Defaults to the name.
machines.model.label: Model
machines.model.help: Optional. Klipper does not report a model, so the host name is shown when this is empty.
machines.vendor.label: Vendor
machines.vendor.help: Optional. Shown as Klipper when empty.
machines.connector.label: Connector
machines.connector.help: The name of the connector in the server configuration whose type is moonraker.
machines.waiting.title: Connecting
machines.waiting.lead: Added {name}. Waiting for it to answer.
machines.waiting.slow.title: It has not connected yet
machines.waiting.slow.body: Check that Moonraker answers at {address}, and that the server configuration has a connector named {connector} with type moonraker. A Moonraker that needs an API key is not supported yet.
machines.connected.title: Connected
